title: [yugabyted] `yugabyted configure data_placement` not working with cluster when nodes were started with DNS name as `--advertise_address`

labels.name: area/ecosystem
labels.description: Label for all ecosystem related projects

body:
Jira Link: [DB-5670](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5670)
### Description

When a cluster was started with nodes' `--advertise_adddress` as their DNS names, the configure step is giving an error.

Steps to replicate: 

On 3 different VMs:

VM1:
```
[gargsans@dev-sgarg-gcp1 bin]$ ./yugabyted start --advertise_address=dev-sgarg-gcp1.us-west1-b.c.yugabyte.internal --cloud_location=gcp.us-west1.us-west-1b
```
